title: A Martindale-like Ring of Quotients for any ring
summary: In this paper we introduce a Martindale-like ring of quotients for any ring called sub-Martindale ring of quotients. When the base ring is semiprime, its maximal sub-Martindale ring of quotients is just the well-known Martindale ring of quotients. In a similar fashion we introduce some rings of quotients for any ring similar to Martindale symmetric ring of quotients.
